source.reason: Repository contains not-captured P0 production replay manifests but no committed NDJSON camera recordings. Synthetic replay frames were used to keep the required regression metrics comparable and deterministic.

baseline.description: Legacy pose-snapshot fallback input with identical synthetic pose/solver samples.

candidate.description: Canonical temporal primary input with identical synthetic pose/solver samples.

notes: The artifact does not claim real camera P0 coverage. It records the deterministic comparison available in this repository and keeps the not-captured limitation explicit.
Production behavior is covered by targeted unit tests for temporal primary, pose fallback reasons, and Phase 6 legacy source parsing.
